renodx_framework.policy: latest upstream main at build time; exact SHA recorded in BUILD-MANIFEST.json

reshade.policy: latest official Standard or Full Add-on build resolved from reshade.me according to install mode

reshade_effects.policy: latest official packages required by shipped presets

presets.note: Main includes QuantV settings; QuantV itself is external/proprietary and is not downloaded from unofficial mirrors.

renodx_dlss5_consumer.source: RankFTW/rhi-repo release mirror used by DLSS5-Feeder
renodx_dlss5_consumer.redistribution: downloaded at install time; not bundled

nvidia_dlss_sr.redistribution: downloaded at install time; not bundled

nvidia_dlss_nr.redistribution: downloaded at install time; not bundled

nvidia_streamline.redistribution: downloaded from NVIDIA at install time; not bundled

install_modes.Auto: RTX 50-class GPUs select FullNeural; other hardware selects VisualOnly
install_modes.FullNeural: validated neural runtime path for RTX 50-class hardware
install_modes.VisualOnly: GPU-agnostic ReShade preset/shader path without neural native add-ons
